headline: Executive order setting new pay rates for federal workers, likely the yearly pay adjustment for 2002.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order adjusts pay rates for certain federal jobs. Orders with this title are usually the yearly update to federal pay schedules. No summary was provided, so the exact pay changes and the groups covered are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates are likely changed under the new pay schedules set by the order.
